LiveSQLBench (BIRD-SQL Pro v0.5) is a contamination-free, continuously evolving benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on complex, real-world text-to-SQL tasks
Each task pairs unambiguous user queries with annotated, gold-standard SQL statements.
Every DB includes a hierarchical knowledge base (HKB) where each knowledge is related to others, which requires the multi-hop reasoning ability.
Two HKB formats are provided: (1) structured JSON format, and (2) unstructured Document format.
Supports not just SELECT (Business Intelligence) queries, but also CRUD (e.g., UPDATE, CREATE, and other database management operations) queries.
Each question includes verifiable test cases for accurate, reproducible scoring.

New databases and tasks are added over time. Each release features both open development and hidden test phases. The hidden test set from each release becomes the open development set for the next release, ensuring continuous evolution and fair evaluation.
Business rules embedded in external knowledge can change across releases, requiring models to adapt to updated context rather than relying on memorized patterns.
Constructed dynamically from extensive and regularly updated CSV datasets

This paper introduces BIRD, a Big benchmark for large-scale database grounded in text-to-SQL tasks, containing 12,751 pairs of text-to-SQL data and 95 databases with a total size of 33.4 GB, spanning 37 professional domains.
BIRD-INTERACT evaluates text-to-SQL systems through dynamic multi-turn interactions with both users and database environments.
